page_title: NOT 1-2 ARS | Nottingham Forest v Arsenal 30/01/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+8' That's all for today as the game is over.
90+8' Danilo (Nottingham) flights in the cross, but the defender is alert and clears to safety.
90+5' Murillo (Nottingham) robs an opponent of the ball and explodes in anger when Simon Hooper blows for a foul.
90+3' Taiwo Awoniyi (Nottingham) fails to score from the rebound as the goalkeeper stops his effort from hitting the net.
90+3' Danilo (Nottingham) sends in the corner, but the keeper steps in and makes a save.
90+2' Morgan Gibbs-White (Nottingham) unleashes a powerful shot towards goal, but it is bravely blocked by a self-sacrificing defender.
90+2' Mikel Arteta decides to make a substitution. Oleksandr Zinchenko will be replaced by Jakub Kiwior (Arsenal).
90+2' Martin Odegaard goes off the pitch and Jorginho (Arsenal) comes on.
90+2' Anthony Elanga (Nottingham) produces a dangerous low pass into the penalty area, but the defence manage to cut it out.
90+1' Here comes the VAR decision. The goal is given and Nottingham players have a reason to celebrate!
90' There will be a minimum of 5 min. of added time.
90' The Nottingham players halt their celebrations as referee Simon Hooper makes the VAR signal to review the goal, most likely to ascertain if there was an offside in the build-up play.
89' 1 - 2 Goal! Taiwo Awoniyi (Nottingham) pounced on a loose ball inside the penalty area and beats the goalkeeper with a shot into the bottom right corner. He makes it 1:2.
87' Simon Hooper blows his whistle and it's Bukayo Saka (Arsenal) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee.
85' Bukayo Saka (Arsenal) takes a mid-range shot, but it lacks accuracy and it goes way over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Nottingham will have a goal kick.
85' Bukayo Saka (Arsenal) sends the corner into the box, but Matt Turner intercepts it and averts the threat.
84' Bukayo Saka (Arsenal) blasts the ball from just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by the defender.
83' Matt Turner leaps to collect the ball from the corner which was sent over by Bukayo Saka (Arsenal).
83' Eddie Nketiah (Arsenal) collects a pass inside the box and unleashes a shot which is brilliantly blocked by a defender.
82' Harry Toffolo (Nottingham) delivers a fine lofted cross into the penalty area, but it's cleared by an opposing player.

81' What a chance that is! Leandro Trossard (Arsenal) finds himself unmarked in a promising position after receiving a cross on the edge of the box and his attempt sails a whisker wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Nottingham will have a goal kick.
81' Harry Toffolo (Nottingham) sends a cross into the box, but David Raya comes off his line to gather the ball.
81' Some neat passing and movement from Arsenal as they ping around some short passes in order to create a new attacking opportunity.
78' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Gabriel Jesus departs the field of play to be replaced by Eddie Nketiah (Arsenal).
78' Mikel Arteta has decided to substitute Gabriel Martinelli and he is replaced by Leandro Trossard (Arsenal).
78' The manager has decided to make a substitution and Neco Williams walks off the pitch to be replaced by Anthony Elanga (Nottingham).
74' Murillo (Nottingham) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Simon Hooper blows his whistle for a foul.
72' 0 - 2 Bukayo Saka (Arsenal) receives the ball inside the box, reacts quickly and without any problems stabs the ball low inside the left post.
72' Nottingham failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
71' Here comes a substitution. Ryan Yates (Nottingham) is brought on as a substitute for Orel Mangala.
71' Mikel Arteta prepares a substitution. Emile Smith Rowe is replaced by Kai Havertz (Arsenal).
67' The ball goes out of play. Arsenal are awarded a corner kick.
66' The linesman raises his flag. Callum Hudson-Odoi (Nottingham) is adjudged offside.
65' 0 - 1 Gabriel Jesus (Arsenal) receives the ball inside the box, reacts quickly and without any problems stabs the ball low in the middle of the goal.
64' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Callum Hudson-Odoi (Nottingham) comes onto the pitch for Nicolas Dominguez.
63' 20:80 – this is the current ball possession ratio.
60' The linesman raises his flag for offside before Gabriel Jesus (Arsenal) heads on.
59' Gabriel Jesus (Arsenal) has to stretch for the ball in the box and sends it high over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Nottingham.
58' The free kick from close range, taken by Arsenal, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
58' Simon Hooper couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Neco Williams (Nottingham) and blew his whistle.
57' Gabriel Jesus (Arsenal) gathers the ball inside the box and produces a snap shot. The ball only rattles the right post.
56' Declan Rice (Arsenal) whips in the corner, but one of the defending players gets a head on it and intercepts.
56' Gabriel Martinelli (Arsenal) delivers a lovely cross into the penalty area. Nevertheless, an opposition defender is alert and averts the danger with a brilliant clearance.
55' Bukayo Saka (Arsenal) takes the corner, but the goalkeeper jumps and gathers the ball.
54' Bukayo Saka (Arsenal) tries to pass the ball into the penalty area but it's blocked.
53' A pass into the box finds Bukayo Saka (Arsenal) unmarked. He carefully places a shot towards the middle of the goal, but a brilliant last-ditch save by Matt Turner denies him.

53' Neco Williams (Nottingham) is strong enough to get to the ball and produces a header from close range. Even though it was aimed precisely towards the middle of the goal, David Raya didn't have a hard time stopping the attempt as it wasn't powerful enough.
52' William Saliba (Arsenal) pulls the shirt of his opponent and the referee stops play for a foul.
51' Neco Williams (Nottingham) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared.
50' Gabriel Martinelli (Arsenal) tries to send the ball in front of the goal, but the opposition's defence averts the threat.
46' Half-time substitution. Chris Wood (Nottingham) will not participate anymore and Taiwo Awoniyi is coming on.
46' The game restarts for the second half.
45+4' Simon Hooper blows his whistle to signal the end of the first-half action.
45+4' Gabriel Jesus (Arsenal) rises above the opponent's defence and heads a precise cross towards the top left corner. The effort, however, is blocked by Matt Turner, who pulls off a stunning save!
45+3' Ben White (Arsenal) dinks a cross into the box in an attempt to find one of his teammates, but the defence manages to clear.
45+1' A cross is whipped into the centre of the box towards Gabriel Jesus (Arsenal). He gets a good contact on the ball but heads it high over the bar.
45' 3 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
44' Simon Hooper has a clear sight and sees a foul from Gabriel (Arsenal).
44' Declan Rice (Arsenal) launches the ball from the resulting corner, but one of the defenders is first to the ball and deals with the threat.
44' Bukayo Saka (Arsenal) shoots inside the box, but is denied by a timely block. Arsenal will take a corner kick.
43' Ben White (Arsenal) whips the ball in, but it fails to reach any of his teammates as the opposition's defence averts the threat.

42' Danilo (Nottingham) unleashed a long-range shot, but it misses narrowly over the bar. It could have been the goal of the month, at least. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Arsenal.
40' Gabriel Jesus (Arsenal) receives a yellow card from the referee as expected.
40' Martin Odegaard (Arsenal) has a shot blocked from inside the box.
39' Ben White (Arsenal) passes the ball from the edge of the box in order to find his teammate, who is in a good scoring position, but the defender blocks the pass and spanks the ball to safety.
38' Gonzalo Montiel (Nottingham) is able to continue to play.
38' Bukayo Saka (Arsenal) misses a good chance to score. An inch-perfect cross into the box finds Bukayo Saka (Arsenal) who rises for a header, but sends the ball well over the bar.
36' Gonzalo Montiel (Nottingham) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
35' The defender bravely blocks the shot from Gabriel Jesus (Arsenal) inside the box.
35' Martin Odegaard (Arsenal) crosses into the box from near the side line, but he doesn't connect as he wanted and it's cleared by the well-organized defence.
34' Arsenal keep possession of the ball with some short passes, waiting for the moment to hit the opposition swiftly on the break.
32' Gabriel Jesus (Arsenal) attempts to set up his teammate with a scoring opportunity by chipping in a fine pass from the edge of the box, but one of the defenders intercepts his effort.

31' That was close by Emile Smith Rowe (Arsenal)! He receives a pass on the edge of the box and shoots, but the ball goes inches wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Nottingham will have a goal kick.
29' Gabriel Jesus (Arsenal) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
27' Declan Rice (Arsenal) swings in the corner, but it's comfortably cleared away.
27' Gabriel Martinelli (Arsenal) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence. It will be a corner kick for Arsenal.
26' The resulting free kick from Martin Odegaard (Arsenal) ends up in the gloves of the keeper.
25' The referee blows his whistle, a clear handball by Neco Williams (Nottingham).
25' The ball is whipped in from the corner by Declan Rice (Arsenal), but one of the defenders gets it clear.

23' Gabriel Martinelli (Arsenal) unleashed a monstrous piledriver. He controlled a pass, glanced up at goal and shot from the edge of the box. It could have been a difficult one for the keeper, but the ball fortunately hit one of the defenders and ball bounced away.
22' Gabriel Martinelli (Arsenal) attempts to find the head of one of his teammates with a promising cross into the box, but a defender outjumps the attackers and averts the threat.
22' The percentage of ball possession is – 29:71.
20' Bukayo Saka (Arsenal) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Matt Turner, who smothers the ball.
19' Murillo (Nottingham) was too forceful with his tackle and Simon Hooper interrupted the game to signal a free kick.

19' Nicolas Dominguez (Nottingham) attempts to find some of his teammates with a dangerous pass from the edge of the box. The opponent's defence, however, intercepts the effort and clears the ball to safety.
18' The linesman signals that Gabriel Jesus (Arsenal) is offside and the referee confirms the decision.
17' Matt Turner (Nottingham) seems to be alright and is okay to carry on.
16' The game is interrupted now, Matt Turner (Nottingham) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
15' Ben White (Arsenal) fails to beat the offside trap and the linesman puts his flag up.
15' Declan Rice (Arsenal) works the corner short instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
15' Oleksandr Zinchenko (Arsenal) delivers a low pass into the box which is intercepted.
13' A defender unwittingly blocks the ball on the line after a snap shot from Martin Odegaard (Arsenal) inside the box following a slide rule pass.
13' A spell of possession for Arsenal in an attempt to control the game.
11' Bukayo Saka (Arsenal) attempts to find a teammate with the corner, but the effort is snuffed out by the goalkeeper.
10' Bukayo Saka (Arsenal) sends a sweet pass into the penalty area, but one of the defenders averts the danger.
8' A cross into the box from Oleksandr Zinchenko (Arsenal) is cleared.
6' Nicolas Dominguez (Nottingham) tries to send a pass but it's blocked.
4' The referee blows his whistle as Martin Odegaard (Arsenal) was too aggressive in his challenge.
4' Gabriel Jesus (Arsenal) tries to send a low pass into the box, but it's blocked and cleared.
1' Gabriel Martinelli (Arsenal) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Simon Hooper no option but to blow his whistle.
1' The first half has started.
The players are out at last! Arsenal will take the kick-off.
Simon Hooper was nominated as the referee for this game.
